...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Illinois...

Illinois River at Beardstown affecting Cass, Morgan, Brown and
Schuyler Counties.

Illinois River near Havana affecting Cass, Fulton and Mason
Counties.

.The following forecasts are based on observed precipitation, soil
moisture conditions, and forecast precipitation.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Illinois River at Beardstown.

* WHEN...Until Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 14.4 feet, Seepage problems begin in the Coal Creek
Drainage and Levee District.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:45 AM CDT Tuesday the stage was 16.1 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 7:45 AM CDT Tuesday was 16.3 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
Monday morning and continue falling to 13.5 feet Tuesday,
September 01.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

latest forecasts and associated flood risk for their area. Stay tuned
for further updates on this flooding situation.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 130 AM CDT.
